The stock market is a complex and ever-changing system, and as such, it can be difficult to predict which way the market will move. However, by using a variety of technical analysis methods, we can get a better understanding of the market's current trends and make more informed investment decisions. The five technical analysis methods used to write this report are Moving Averages, Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD), Fibonacci Retracement, Bollinger Bands & Relative Strength Index (RSI).

Moving Averages (MA) are a widely used technical analysis tool that helps to smooth out price data by creating a constantly updated average price. The most common types of moving averages are the simple moving average (SMA) and the exponential moving average (EMA). The MA for this stock is currently at 8, this is a neutral score as there is an equal chance of a price increase or decrease. 

Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) is a momentum indicator that shows the relationship between two moving averages. The MACD is calculated by subtracting the 26-day EMA from the 12-day EMA. The MACD for this stock is currently at 6, again this is neutral.

Fibonacci Retracement is a technical analysis technique that identifies potential support and resistance levels based on the Fibonacci sequence. The Fibonacci sequence is a series of numbers in which each number is the sum of the two preceding numbers. The most common Fibonacci retracement levels are 23.6%, 38.2%, 50%, 61.8%, and 78.6%. The Fibonacci Retracement for this stock is currently at 9 implying that there is a high chance of an increase in price.

Bollinger Bands are a volatility indicator that helps to identify overbought and oversold conditions. Bollinger Bands are created by calculating the moving average of a security's price and then adding and subtracting two standard deviations from the moving average. The Bollinger Bands for this stock is currently at 4, this is again neutral but leaning slightly towards a rise in price.

The Relative Strength Index (RSI) is a momentum indicator that measures the magnitude of recent price changes to evaluate overbought or oversold conditions. The RSI is calculated by comparing the average gain of up periods to the average loss of down periods. The RSI for this stock is currently at 7 which suggests that it is currently overbought.
